original_claims.claim: 4. **#12777, Codex stdout EOF termination** — [open PR](https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code/pull/12777), head `f26b55dfbb93fe24a1765b4f775f587aba1ec8c3`, updated 1 October. claim.reason: At stdout EOF the local protocol awaits the optional child-process exit diagnostic before failing pending requests. non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Atomic reservation/launch state, retry identity and reconciliation needed before owned delegation. Multiple processes do not share the in-memory queue.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Code follow-up queue is client-owned and drains with mounted chat.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: composerDraftStore persists queued messages locally; ChatView queue-drain effect inspects current phase/draft and sends next message.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Future server queue must preserve content/order/attachments/edit/cancel/restart; browser persistence is not unattended execution proof.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: MCP narrowing versus authenticated raw command mismatch is authority gap, not unauthenticated exploit.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: Current upstream WS middleware requires operate scope and creation provenance is server stamped as user. Delegated raw request checks active parent/run/node but uses command modes. Local headless auth/tickets exist and README qualifies legacy desktop bootstrap. Child credential possession is unproven.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Separate trusted-human operate authority from agent-origin capability ceilings; establish actual auth credential reachability before exploit claims. Do not import removed upstream auth infrastructure.
non_pr_findings.corrections: A raw operate caller intentionally broad authority is not automatically a vulnerability. The architectural gap is reliance on helper-only restriction for any promised app-owned-agent ceiling.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: V2 does not supply dedicated Copilot/Kiro parity; generic ACP support is not compatibility proof.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: Inspected built-in array includesCodex/Claude/Cursor/OpenCode/Grok/Pi/ACPRegistry, no dedicatedCopilot/Kiro. Local Kiro is supervised/approval-required withCrew/Symphony/fullaccess disabled.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Representative current provider/version/capability/conformance evidence before replacement; native child observation grants no owned cancellation authority.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Symphony is separate tracker dispatch execution plane and directly spawns Codex.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: RunnerAgentRuntime imports CodexClient and spawns app-server from codexCommand; interactive engine/provider service is not its dispatch executor. Shared server process is not shared accepted-command authority.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: A one-orchestrator/admission/audit claim must cover both planes, by common admission or explicit dual instrumentation. No live tracker-to-PR run evidence supplied.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Parsed-only policy/limits differ from enforced Codex approvals, run caps and merge gates.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: Config parses maxRunDuration/concurrencyProvider/approvalsBefore*/protectedPaths; runtime source searches do not establish those keys as enforced safety gates. Dispatcher uses effective Codex approval policy and existing orchestration/merge controls.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Current unrelated Symphony work must be validated by its owner; prove controls on actual end-to-end evidence path before increased autonomy.
non_pr_findings.corrections: This finding reads dirty current source as observation only, not review approval of owner implementation. Project maxConcurrentAgents maps into concurrencyGlobal; do not call all similarly named caps unenforced.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Send ABC-123 to Symphony can reuse Jira connection but needs canonical issue identity and durable chat linkage.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: Jira bulk fetch accepts issueIdsOrKeys. Adapter maps raw.id as canonicalID and raw.key as identifier/nativeRef. Current delegate contract has objective/thread, no tracker task field; handler verifies thread then creates manual source and delegated-ID without persisting thread in source.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Resolve/displaykey/canonicalID once; validate tracker scope/state/blockers; claim/reuse normal item; durable request/conversation/result linkage, duplicate/restart/cancel and workspace gates. Authentication is not dispatchability or write capability. No Jira service call performed.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Existing handoff helps ownership transfer but does not unify Code/Symphony lifecycle/native session.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: takeOver/resume use fenced ownership transfer and thread/workitem binding. delegate creates manual item separately. This is transfer machinery, not native provider continuity.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Keep one owner per workspace, require explicit transfer or separate allocation, durable linked receipt/outcome; Codex-only target may need bounded briefing.
non_pr_findings.corrections: Existing ownership code is not blanket proof every race is safe, especially unrelated changed Symphony files.

non_pr_findings.original_claim: Prefer incremental core evolution, keep replacement comparison open behind measured prototype and migration gates.
non_pr_findings.independent_finding: Existing command persistence/recovery/provider/UI investment and separate Symphony plane make wholesale replacement a broad contract/history migration. V2 implements valuable primitives, but source cannot quantify comparative integration/maintenance cost.
non_pr_findings.remaining_gates: Comparable Codex+Claude chat prototype, fault recovery/history copy/rollback, local latency/memory and later tracker parity before replacement release. Preserve current native credentials and legacy data.
non_pr_findings.corrections: This is a justified design judgement, not empirical proof evolution always cheaper or fresh engine technically inseparable.
